summary: Full backend + frontend testing for (A) Storefront Page Map on /admin/tiles, /admin/flooring, /admin/materials, and (B) 'Customers Also Liked' related-series carousel on /shop/collection/<Series>. All spec requirements verified successfully. 3/3 backend pytest tests pass. All admin page-map data-testids present with correct summaries, tab chips, notab/live counts, shop links, step-3/4 content, localStorage persistence, and show-gaps filter behavior. Storefront renders 8 related-series cards for Opaco, all with images and £ prices, right chevron arrow visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AdminDashboard emits a React 'unique key' warning in console (pre-existing, not related to new features).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/tiles/related/{series}?limit=8 is cached via bulletproof_endpoint. Preview DB has enough tiles: Opaco and Dolomite%20Onyx both return 8 items with images and prices > 0. Unknown series returns 200 with empty related_series. Admin page-map testids follow pattern {tiles|flooring|materials}-page-map-* with children -toggle, -summary, -body, -shop-link, -tab-*, -notab-count, -live-count, -show-gaps, and (flooring only) -sample-series. localStorage key tsm_pagemap_open_{category} controls expanded state. On /admin/tiles the notab count was 17 which matched the visible product count after clicking Show gaps. Managers take ~5–8s to load — wait for the page-map card testid before asserting.
